title: Coupler Dynamic Attributes
description: Binds an advanced connector on this subpart as the active end. The passive end is not configured here: at runtime the coupler discovers the nearest compatible simple connector in the same vehicle by distance and by both parts' installation conditions.

definition.description: Resource location of the coupler definition.

connector.description: Name of the active advanced connector; one advanced connector holds at most one coupler.

state_outputs.description: Output channels for the latched state. Every channel carries a number each tick: 1 when latched, 0 when not (no part installed, already unlatched, or the latch was knocked off). The channel name is chosen by the author and scoped to the whole assembly's signal storage, so two couplers on the same assembly need two distinct names; a gating condition in another part reads it with global.get.
